recipes.title: Mexican beef picadillo with potatoes, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Mexican picadillo with lean ground beef, potatoes, peppers and carrots in a savoury tomato sauce, served with warm tortillas.

steps.instruction: Prepare the potato, tortilla, bell pepper, carrot, onion and garlic in their listed forms.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Brown the ground beef until no pink remains and the edges begin to colour.
Cook the onion, bell pepper and carrot until softened.
Stir the garlic, cumin, paprika, tomato paste and salt into the beef until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, potato and vegetable broth.
Simmer the picadillo until the potato is tender and the sauce is thick.
Warm the tortilla in a dry pan until soft and lightly spotted.
Rest the Mexican beef picadillo so the sauce settles.
Serve the picadillo with the warm tortilla.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the picadillo for up to 4 days and the tortillas separately. Reheat gently until steaming. Freeze the picadillo for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: American meatloaf with mashed potatoes, light
recipes.summary: A lighter American meatloaf with carrots and mushrooms, served with creamy mashed potatoes and green beans. Less bread, butter and potato keep it balanced.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Prepare the potato, green beans, mushrooms, onion, carrot and bread in their listed forms.
Pulse the bread into coarse crumbs in a food processor.
Cook the onion, carrot and mushrooms in the olive oil until soft and lightly browned.
Mix the ground beef, bread crumbs, eggs, half the tomato paste, paprika, half the salt and cooked vegetables.
Shape the meatloaf mixture into a compact loaf in a baking dish.
Spread the remaining tomato paste over the meatloaf.
Bake the meatloaf until browned and cooked through.
Simmer the potato until completely tender.
Steam the green beans until tender but still bright.
Mash the potato with the whole milk, butter and remaining salt.
Rest the meatloaf before slicing.
Serve the meatloaf with the mashed potato and green beans.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the meatloaf, potatoes and green beans separately for up to 3 days. Reheat covered until hot. Freeze sliced meatloaf for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: British fish pie, light
recipes.summary: A lighter British fish pie with cod, salmon, leeks and spinach beneath a modest creamy potato topping.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Prepare the cod, salmon, potato, leek and spinach in their listed forms.
Simmer the potato until completely tender.
Cook the leek in half the butter until soft and sweet.
Fold the spinach into the leek until wilted.
Pour the whole milk and heavy cream into the pan.
Stir the thyme and half the salt into the sauce.
Simmer the sauce gently until it thickens slightly.
Arrange the cod and salmon in a baking dish.
Pour the leek and spinach sauce over the fish.
Mash the potato with the remaining butter and salt.
Spread the mashed potato over the fish filling.
Scatter the parmesan cheese over the potato.
Bake the fish pie until bubbling and golden.
Rest the British fish pie before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 2 days and reheat covered until piping hot. The fish pie is best fresh and is not recommended for freezing.

recipes.title: Indian beef keema with potatoes, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Indian keema with ground beef, potatoes, spinach and tomatoes, warmly seasoned with cumin, ginger, garlic and paprika.

steps.instruction: Prepare the potato, spinach, onion, garlic and ginger in their listed forms.
Heat the olive oil in a wide saucepan over medium-high heat.
Brown the ground beef until no pink remains and the edges begin to colour.
Cook the onion until soft and golden.
Stir the garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika and salt into the beef until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, potato and vegetable broth.
Simmer the keema until the potato is tender and the sauce is thick.
Fold the spinach into the keema until fully wilted.
Rest the Indian beef keema so the flavours settle.
Serve the keema while hot.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 4 days and reheat gently until steaming. Freeze the keema for up to 3 months.

recipes.title: Italian chicken cacciatore with spaghetti, light
recipes.summary: A lighter Italian chicken cacciatore with peppers, mushrooms and tomatoes, served with a modest portion of spaghetti and plenty of vegetables.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, spaghetti, bell pepper, mushrooms, onion, zucchini, garlic and basil in their listed forms.
Heat the olive oil in a wide heavy saucepan.
Brown the chicken thigh on several sides.
Cook the onion, bell pepper and mushrooms until softened and lightly browned.
Cook the zucchini until tender at the edges.
Stir the garlic and thyme into the vegetables until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, vegetable broth and salt.
Simmer the chicken cacciatore until the thigh is tender and the sauce is rich.
Cook the spaghetti until tender with a slight bite.
Fold the basil through the cacciatore sauce.
Rest the chicken cacciatore before serving it with the spaghetti.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the cacciatore and spaghetti separately for up to 3 days. Reheat gently until steaming. Freeze the chicken sauce for up to 2 months.
